title: Toptal: Senior Integration Engineer for Enterprise API & Integration Products
description_review: Senior remote integration engineer building MuleSoft/API integrations across Salesforce, SAP and a carrier data lake, with end-to-end production ownership of API contracts, mapping, testing and monitoring. AI copilots and agents are an explicit daily expectation. No salary or years-of-experience stated.
pros: Senior end-to-end API design and integration ownership matches enterprise software strengths
Enterprise domain (Salesforce, SAP, data lake) aligns with modernization focus
AI-assisted engineering explicitly required, matching applied AI experience
cons: MuleSoft-centric stack, no Java or Spring Boot in the description

title: Sticker Mule: AI agent engineer
description_review: Remote AI agent engineer at Sticker Mule who identifies agent opportunities, builds and manages a team of autonomous agents, connects them to tools and measures results. Stack is Go, TypeScript, GraphQL, Postgres and GCP; salary $150,000–$250,000 USD per year.
pros: Building and orchestrating autonomous agents matches multi-agent platform experience
TypeScript is part of the candidate stack
Disclosed salary band of $150,000–$250,000 USD fully remote
cons: Core stack is Go/GCP/GraphQL, no Java or Spring Boot
No banking, fintech or enterprise modernization domain
No seniority requirement stated beyond running agents

title: Toptal: Senior Data Engineer – AWS Data Lake & Pipeline Architecture
description_review: Remote senior data engineer for a Data Intelligence Platform on AWS, focused on SQL data modeling, pipeline automation, database performance and scalable data architecture. Touches personalization and recommendation engines; no salary or seniority years stated.
pros: Participates in architecture design of scalable data solutions
cons: Data engineering focus with no Java, Spring Boot or microservices backend work
Little applied AI or legacy modernization beyond recommendation engines

title: Proxify AB: Senior Fullstack Developer (React.js / Node.js)
description_review: Senior fullstack contractor role via Proxify for a client, building React.js and Node.js applications with microservices architecture and SQL/MongoDB databases. Requires 5+ years experience and CET timezone; paid monthly with no salary figure disclosed.
pros: Senior fullstack scope with backend depth and microservices architecture
5+ years seniority requirement matches experience level
cons: Node.js/React stack instead of Java and Spring Boot
No banking, fintech or enterprise modernization domain stated

title: Fin: Solutions Architect -Spanish Speaking
description_review: Solutions Architect at Fin (part of Salesforce) acting as trusted advisor to customers on the AI customer agent Fin and Salesforce Agentforce, defining and demonstrating value across the customer journey. NYC/SF remote; no salary or years-of-experience stated.
pros: Agentic AI product environment matches applied multi-agent experience
Enterprise customer exposure within the Salesforce ecosystem
cons: Customer-facing advisory architecture rather than hands-on software engineering
No Java, Spring Boot, microservices or modernization delivery in the description
